# Introduction
{{"template":"referral","description":"an unobtainable block","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is an unobtainable block introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / aimagg:prealpha"}} and reintroduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_base:0.0.3"}}. When mod author {{"of":"to_base:author / to_base:joshmanisdabomb"}} starts a new modding project, it is usually the second block implemented for testing purposes.

These test blocks can be placed horizontally, facing against the placing player. The blue face is the front of the block, while the top and bottom faces are green.
